classes.how: the class Generation 3 Evolved's ROM gives the same Pokémon, matched by national dex number

rules.text: Only one Pokémon can Mega Evolve per battle
rules.why: hg-engine's battle code: once the player has Mega Evolved (newBS.PlayerMegaed, set by MegaEvolutionOrUltraBurst), the Mega button isn't drawn again until the battle ends. Run in this game (version 1.0.12): in a wild battle Venusaur holding Venusaurite took its Mega form with the Mega button; Blastoise holding Blastoisinite, switched in, got a move screen with no Mega button and stayed form 0, while leading another battle it had the button.
